translation: Took place in posad Serock, 16 August 1890, [unclear: 7/8] AM. Appeared personally [unclear: Gerszek] Jagoda, trader, 27, and Lipa Sztatzinger, trader, 60, both residing in Serock, and declared that yesterday at 7 PM in posad Serock died Jankiel [unclear: Groniewicz/Broniewicz], nine months of age, son of Aron and Chaja Maria née Pokorna. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Jankiel [unclear: Groniewicz] this act was read to the witnesses, signed by us and one witness; the second witness is illiterate.
